display_long_description:
Nightmare Monke is a free multiplayer VR social survival game where chaos, exploration, and monsters collide.

🌍 Explore with friends

Team up with your friends or join public lobbies and jump into strange, unpredictable worlds.
Every session is different, every run can go wrong… fast.

👁️ Survive the unknown
Explore eerie environments
Discover hidden areas
Survive encounters with mysterious creatures

The maps are full of danger, secrets, and stuff you really shouldn’t touch… but you will anyway.

🎮 Mess around & interact

Grab simple interactive objects like radios, fun props, and random items.
Use them to:

troll your friends 😈
survive longer
or just create pure chaos
🐵 Customize your monkey

Create your own character with unique skins and styles to stand out in every lobby.

⚡ Every game is a story

Run, explore, scream, laugh, repeat.
No two sessions are the same — it always turns into chaos somehow.
